# smallstep_relay (Resource)

A network relay enforces certificate-based access to a set of allowed network targets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "smallstep_relay" "corp_relay" {
  name     = "CorpRelay"
  hostname = "relay.example.com"

  ca_chain = file("${path.module}/relay_ca_chain.crt")

  allowed_targets = ["ssh.internal.example.com", "db.internal.example.com"]

  issuing_authority_id = smallstep_authority.my_authority.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ca_chain` (String) The certificate authority bundle that client certificates must chain up to.
- `hostname` (String) The hostname clients use to reach the relay server.
- `name` (String) A human-friendly name for this relay.

### Optional

- `allowed_targets` (List of String) The network targets the relay will forward traffic to.
- `issuing_authority_id` (String) A UUID identifying the authority that issues certificates to the relay server itself.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) A UUID identifying this network relay. Read only.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import smallstep_relay.corp_relay 1f8a4c62-7b3d-4e59-9a0c-6d2e8f5b7a13
```
